observations: M1, M2, M3 and M5 currently organize the visible whole product on the left and major title/body/event/visit information on the right despite different material names.
M4 places the copy on an open book and adjacent paper, a different spatial carrier; it still stages one prominent lamp with attached small printed information.
M3 retains a passive pale field and large upper-right gothic heading with separated lower information; it is an observed default-composition concern, not a blanket objection to gothic fonts.

Coordinating positive design must commit different whole composition and reading relationships before material choices; current first-generation body guidance alone does not establish full-set diversity.
future_change_status: proposal only, current S snapshot and actor inputs unchanged
limits: M1–M3 views above are sealed maker choices. M4/M5 are unfinished initial outputs, not final full-set evaluation.
